summary: The registrant, Americas Gold & Silver Corporation, a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three months ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic financial report, not a special-situations event. There are no disclosure of any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing solely provides an update on the company's financial position and results of operations.
